productionProofReview.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.ae_predictable_exists_bounded_history_policy
steps: Select each hP.mk representative with F_t measurability and AE equality. Raise to ordinary comap H_t measurability using hF; no ambient S/Y measurability is inserted.

Apply Measurable.exists_eq_measurable_comp to obtain a globally measurable factor. Its Nonempty/StandardBorel codomain assumptions are discharged by real numbers, not by an illicit StandardBorel Seed premise.
Choose a family of factors and compose with continuous projection to [0,1]. Subtype membership supplies every-seed/every-history boundedness, including off-support inputs.
On each time-specific full-measure agreement-and-bound event, projIcc is identity. ae_all_iff combines natural times into one common event.

productionProofReview.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.ae_predictable_private_seed_independent
steps: Apply existing predictable_private_seed_independent to the F-measurable representative hP.mk P. This existing theorem restricts independent generated sigma fields and consumes no boundedness.

Existing private_seed_past_independent derives past/current independence via disjoint finite indices and transports whole-stream seed independence to (past,current). independent_private_seed_pair regrouping uses exact product-law identities.
IndepFun.congr transfers representative independence to original P by hP.ae_eq_mk.symm. No clamp/T1 call and no moment assumption occurs.
productionProofReview.unselectedAlternative: D2-FACTORED remains a mathematical alternative, not an actual dependency.

productionProofReview.name: BanditRL.OnlineLearning.ae_predictable_private_seed_expectedFixed_excess
steps: Measurable seed and each coordinate make H_t ambient measurable. Compose hF with its comap inclusion, then AEStronglyMeasurable.mono supplies ambient AE measurability.
Probability implies finite measure; memLp_of_bounded with hpb gives L2 prediction regularity. T2 derives prediction/current independence at each t.

expectedFixedMinimum_eq_variance is an actual producer: expected_fixed_prefix_minimum proves mean feasibility and IsLeast, then csInf_eq evaluates the expected-fixed benchmark for every T including zero.

iid_cumulative_prediction_decomposition integrates finite sums using L2, transfers equal-law mean/variance, and reuses independent_prediction_square. The latter uses variance_sub/covariance_eq_zero, the equivalent variance route for the source-topology centered cross-term obligation.
Subtract T variance and sum nonnegative squared integrals. No positive-horizon division, limit, source FTL proof or generic success theorem is used.
productionProofReview.unselectedAlternative: D3-EXPLICIT-POLICY/T1 is not in this proof. It is not promoted to an actual proof edge.

canaryReview.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingAECausal.badPrediction
canaryReview.assessment: Changes the persistent seed-bit prediction to 2 exactly when the unrevealed current target equals 2. This is a genuine nonempty off-support condition on the real product carrier.

canaryReview.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingAECausal.bad_eq_causal_ae
canaryReview.assessment: AE [0,1] target support excludes target=2 and proves equality with the seed-only causal predictor.

canaryReview.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingAECausal.causal_version_measurable
canaryReview.assessment: Seed-bit composition with seed projection is measurable under the ordinary comap history information.

canaryReview.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingAECausal.bad_ae_predictable
canaryReview.assessment: Transfers AE strong measurability across the established AE equality, without asserting pointwise causality.

canaryReview.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingAECausal.bad_ae_unit
canaryReview.assessment: AE equality plus globally feasible seedBit proves AE unit bounds; no pointwise outcome/prediction support introduced.

canaryReview.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingAECausal.bad_is_not_pointwise_predictable
canaryReview.assessment: At t=0, points (seed0,all2) and (seed0,all0) have identical empty-history information but different predictions. Measurable.factorsThrough yields a contradiction.

canaryReview.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingAECausal.bad_is_not_everywhere_unit
canaryReview.assessment: The explicit all2 path at t=0 produces value 2 and contradicts global unit-interval feasibility.

canaryReview.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingAECausal.actual_all_time_bounded_policy
canaryReview.assessment: Genuine T1 existential consumer on the non-pointwise process, establishing measurable bounded policy and one common AE event.

canaryReview.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingAECausal.actual_current_independence
canaryReview.assessment: Genuine T2 consumer with the concrete product seed law and infinite IID coordinates, despite null-event peeking.

canaryReview.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingAECausal.actual_original_excess_identity
canaryReview.assessment: Genuine T3 consumer with every model assumption produced by concrete test lemmas.

canaryReview.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingAECausal.actual_mean_square
canaryReview.assessment: Target mean 1/2 and persistent seedBit in {0,1} yield squared error 1/4 AE; integral_congr_ae and probability mass one give exact value.

canaryReview.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingAECausal.actual_nonzero_excess
canaryReview.assessment: T3 equality plus per-time 1/4 errors gives T/4, demonstrating the finite identity does not imply sublinear success.

canaryReview.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingAECausal.actual_empty_excess
canaryReview.assessment: T=0 gives exactly zero; no illegal division by zero used.

canaryReview.name: Tests.OnlineGuessingAECausal.actual_positive_target_variance
canaryReview.assessment: Concrete target variance is 1/4; example is not a degenerate zero-variance validation.
